concept: Review and integration: what taking care of the natural world feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of noticing nature, leaving places better, and not wasting resources — which feels most natural to you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'stewardship of nature' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
